Target ambiguous: the description does not explicitly select the unadjusted current-emotion contrast (t(93)=2.06, p=.042, d=0.43) versus the temporal-perspective coefficient controlling predicted/remembered enjoyment (b=.129, beta=.163, t(92)=2.18, p=.032, d=0.45). Independence from actual temporal relation is a feature of the hypothetical design and does not uniquely identify the regression-adjusted test. No choice made by row order or numeric matching.
